The '''Caves of Elshuu''' was a series of caves located in [[The Tomb]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the caves housed the [[Mind prison]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] named [[Elshuu]], which was tended by his followers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Caves of Elshuu appears as an area on Belsavis in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
